name: Durval

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health. Pulling him brings five corpse delvers and four white lights; casts a mesmerize, Durval's Plague and Shield of Bones.

story: Durval was a priest of the dead on Caldey before Morgana came, and he took her coming as the answer to his prayers. He keeps a barrow on the isle where his corpse-delvers dig and his white lights hover, and he goes nowhere without them: strike him and the delvers and the lights all turn at once. He spreads a plague of his own brewing, wraps himself in a shield of bones, and lulls the careless to sleep in the middle of the fight so that they wake up surrounded.
legend: Nine of his household come with him: five corpse delvers and four white lights. He mesmerizes, so keep a cure for it handy, and his plague wants curing too. Clear his household, break the bone shield, then him. Never fight him on fresh-dug ground.

aggro: Dig, my delvers. We have guests.

lairEntry: White lights hover over fresh-dug earth.

phases.text: Durval raises his shield of bones!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Durval's barrow is quiet. The delvers stop digging.

aftermathWin: durval down. one less horror on the isles
aftermathLoss: we didnt respect the trick. learn it and come back
